app_identity.name: Amo Pay
app_identity.purpose: Isanduku y'ifaranga ryuzuye na serivisi z'imari zigamije kohereza amafaranga, guhindura ifaranga, na serivisi z'ubucuruzi.

kohereza_amafaranga.title: Ohereza Amafaranga
steps: Hitamo 'Ohereza Amafaranga' ku kibaho cyangwa ku murongo w'ibice.
Injiza ingano y'amafaranga mu ifaranga ryawe (urugero: PLN, USD).
Reba igiciro cy'isimburanwa gifite ubu n'ingano umukiriya azahabwa mu RWF.
Fata igiciro (gihoraho amasegonda 300 / iminota 5) kugira ngo ntagihinduke mu gihe cy'ubwishyu.
Tanga amakuru y'uwakiriye: Izina, Inkomoko y'Amafaranga, na Numero ya Telefone ya Rwanda (+250).
Hitamo uburyo bwo gutanga: Amafaranga kuri Telefone cyangwa Kohereza kwa Banki.
Uzuza ubwishyu ukoresheje Ikarita, BLIK (Polonye), Apple Pay, cyangwa Google Pay.

limits_and_fees.max_transfer: Umupaka ntarengwa wo kohereza ni 5,000,000 RWF ku nshuro imwe.
limits_and_fees.flat_fees: Amafaranga y'ishyu ni: 5 PLN, 2 USD, 2 EUR, cyangwa 2 GBP bitewe n'ifaranga rya konti yawe.

kugenzura_indangamuntu_kyc.title: Kugenzura Indangamuntu (KYC)
kugenzura_indangamuntu_kyc.purpose: Bisabwa kugira ngo ubone imipaka yo kohereza amafaranga myinshi no kurinda umutekano wa konti yawe.
requirements: Indangamuntu y'Igihugu cyangwa Pasiporo (Amafoto imbere n'inyuma)
Ifoto nziza yawe mu cyumba cyaka urumuri
kugenzura_indangamuntu_kyc.process: Ohereza cyangwa fata amafoto ukoresheje kamera yo mu gikoresho. Suzuma inyandiko zose mbere yo gutanga burundu.

serivisi_z_ubucuruzi.title: Serivisi z'Ubucuruzi
serivisi_z_ubucuruzi.how_to_register: Uzuza Izina ry'Ubucuruzi, Telefone y'Ubucuruzi, n'aderesi y'imibereho (ntibisabwa). Ushobora kandi wongeraho kode za MoMo cyangwa Airtel.
serivisi_z_ubucuruzi.benefits: Emera kwishyurwa ukoresheje kode ya QR, gucunga ibikorwa by'ubucuruzi ukoresheje Igikoresho Gisoma cy'Umucuruzi, hanyuma urebe isesengura ry'ubucuruzi ryihariye.

tools.merchant_qr: Kode ya QR y'Umucuruzi: Kode ya QR ihariye abakiriya basoma kugira ngo bakwishyure.
tools.merchant_scanner: Igikoresho Gisoma cy'Umucuruzi: Igikoresho cyifashishwa mu gusoma amakuru yo kwishyura vuba.
tools.merchant_info: Amakuru y'Umucuruzi: Gucunga umwirondoro w'ubucuruzi bwawe.

guhindura_ifaranga.title: Guhindura Ifaranga
guhindura_ifaranga.description: Hindura amafaranga vuba ku giciro gikomeye. Porogaramu itanga amakuru y'igiciro buri munsi n'ubuyobozi bwa AI ku bihe byiza byo guhindura.

inama_z_umutekano.title: Inama z'Umutekano
tips: Fungura Face ID cyangwa Kugenzura mu Mubiri kugira ngo winjire vuba no mu mutekano.
Ntuhe na umwe OTP cyangwa ijambo ryawe ry'ibanga.
Amo Pay ikoresha SecureStore kurinda amatike yawe n'amakuru y'ibanga.

account_states.unverified: Umukoresha ashobora kureba gusa ariko ntashobora kohereza amafaranga. Agomba gusoza KYC mbere.
account_states.kyc_pending: Inyandiko zatanzwe, birindiriwe kugenzurwa. Bisaba amasaha 24-48.
account_states.kyc_verified: Uhabwa uburenganzira bwuzuye ku bigendererwa byose n'imipaka myinshi yo kohereza.
account_states.suspended: Konti ifunzwe. Umukoresha agomba kuvugana n'ubufasha kuri support@amopay.com

error_messages.insufficient_balance: Umuzigo wa wallet yawe ntuhagije. Shyiramo amafaranga hanyuma ugerageze nanone.
error_messages.invalid_recipient: Numero ya telefone y'uwakiriye ntaboneka. Suzuma numero hanyuma ugerageze nanone.
error_messages.session_expired: Igihe cyo kwinjira cyarangiye. Injira nanone.
error_messages.rate_expired: Igiciro cy'isimburanwa cyarangiye nyuma y'iminota 5. Vugurura kugira ngo ubone igiciro gishya.
error_messages.kyc_required: Ibi bisaba kugenzura indangamuntu. Soza KYC mbere.
error_messages.payment_declined: Ubwishyu bwanzwe na banki yawe. Gerageza uburyo bundie bwo kwishyura.
error_messages.network_error: Ikibazo cya interineti. Gerageza nanone nyuma y'umwanya muto.
error_messages.invalid_amount: Ingano y'amafaranga ntabwo ari yo. Injiza ingano igendeye.
error_messages.account_suspended: Konti yawe ifunzwe. Twandikire kuri serivisi z'ubufasha: support@amopay.com.
error_messages.transaction_limit: Urenze umupaka w'ubwishyu wa 5,000,000 RWF. Gerageza ingano ntoya.

ntashobora_gufasha_muri: Guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga ya konti ku buryo butaziguye
Kwinjira mu makuru ya konti y'umukoresha

support_contacts.hours: Kuva ku wa Mbere kugeza ku wa Gatanu, kuva saa mbili za mugitondo kugeza saa kumi n'ebyiri za nimugoroba (Kigali)

amo_assistant_responses.greeting_morning: Mwaramutse! Ndishimiye kukubona kuri Amo Pay. Nagufasha iki uyu munsi?
amo_assistant_responses.greeting_evening: Ijoro ryiza! Nagufasha iki uyu munsi?
amo_assistant_responses.dont_understand: Umbabarire, ntabwo nkubumvise neza. Ongera ubisobanure mu buryo bundi.
amo_assistant_responses.cannot_help: Ibi sinabishobora. Twandikire kuri serivisi z'ubufasha kuri support@amopay.com
amo_assistant_responses.kyc_help: Kugira ngo ugenzure indangamuntu yawe, jya ku mwirondoro wawe hanyuma uhitemo 'Kugenzura Indangamuntu'.
amo_assistant_responses.welcome_back: Murakaza neza nanone kuri Amo Pay!
amo_assistant_responses.transaction_success: Ubwishyu bwagenze neza! Urakoze gukoresha Amo Pay.
amo_assistant_responses.rate_locked: Igiciro gifunzwe kwa minota 5. Vugurura niba girangiye.
amo_assistant_responses.contact_support: Ku bibazo bikomeye, twandikire kuri support@amopay.com cyangwa +250 700 000 000.

rwanda_specific.phone_format: Numero za Rwanda zitangira na +250 ikurikirwa na 7 hanyuma na 2, 3, 8, cyangwa 9

password_requirements.description: Ijambo ry'ibanga rigomba kuba rifite inyuguti 8-128, harimo inyuguti nkuru, inyuguti ntoya, umubare, n'ikimenyetso kidasanzwe.

otp.purpose: Kugenzura ubwawe mbere yo gusoza ibikorwa bikomeye.
